purpose: Characterize which frozen real-soil materials can exhibit a genuine finite-time dry-to-ponded onset under constant supply, before freezing the R2 event-localization qualification fixture. This is fixture research only and may not qualify event localization.

frozen_common_scope.solver_policy: same qualification-only least_squares tolerances and bounds as E3G/R1
frozen_common_scope.capacity_reference: endpoint-aware 5 cm full-accuracy surface-face reference already qualified upstream

required_fixture_signature: g(0)<0 beyond roundoff, so R1 immediate admission does not apply
there exist adjacent sampled positive times t_a<t_b with both dry reference trials mass-valid and g(t_a)<0<=g(t_b)
the top node remains inside the frozen negative-head domain at both bracket endpoints
no unqualified face fallback or mass repair is used
B01_O14_interior_event_scan.selection_rule_if_multiple: Choose the smallest supply fraction, then the earliest valid bracket, independently for each material. A later qualification may use separate material fixtures; no requirement is imposed that B01 and O14 share one onset time.

required.0.995: initial dry admission and no forced finite-time onset claim within this characterization
required.1.005: immediate-at-t0 ponding classification under R1, not a finite-time R2 event

B12_O13_controls.hard_guard: Do not tune an artificial constant-supply finite-time event for B12/O13 when the qualified h_surface=0 endpoint semantics already classify supply above KSAT as immediate ponding.

interpretation_rules.valid_event_bracket: Scientific evidence that an interior finite-time onset fixture exists for that material under the frozen reference composition. It is not yet an event-localization qualification.
interpretation_rules.dry_solver_invalid_before_sign_change: No fixture from that supply/time sequence. Do not infer event time from an invalid state.
interpretation_rules.no_sign_change: No interior onset fixture established in the scanned horizon.
interpretation_rules.B12_or_O13_immediate: Positive control for R1-domain separation, not R2 failure.

architecture_checks.7_transactional_timesteps: Every sampled dry trajectory is computed from the same immutable committed state and is never committed.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: All sample times are offsets in a generic [t0,t1] interval, with no day-boundary semantics.
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation_absolute: Only mass-valid dry reference samples can establish a bracket.
architecture_checks.23_physics_solver_policy_separated: The event function is physical complementarity; the sampling grid is qualification-only policy.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: This is bounded fixture characterization, not a production search algorithm.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: Only independently qualified reference physics establishes the fixture class.
architecture_checks.29_no_silent_dependencies: All geometry, heads, forcing fractions and times are explicit.

hard_nonclaims: No event time is qualified by R2A.
No candidate event locator is tested.
No production event-search cadence follows from the sample grid.
No finite-time event is required for B12/O13.
No top-node positive head, pond depletion, runoff, response tangent, runtime, MultiSWAP or MODFLOW admission.
